title: IP addresses and colors
hints: `fmt` calls `String()` automatically for `Print`, `Println`, `%v` and `%s`. You just need to build the right string with `fmt.Sprintf`.
An `IPAddr` is an array: index it with `ip[0]` … `ip[3]` and format each byte with `%d`. For hex, the verb `%02x` prints a number as two lowercase hex digits, padded with a zero.
`return fmt.Sprintf("%d.%d.%d.%d", ip[0], ip[1], ip[2], ip[3])` and `return fmt.Sprintf("#%02x%02x%02x", c.R, c.G, c.B)`.
